name: factory
description: A software factory for Claude Code in one plugin: a working agreement whose hooks enforce scope, secrets, route auth, test quality and verify-before-commit as a ratchet over today's debt; a code graph and evidence-gated ledger served over MCP (server graph) with an orchestrator; an epic writer; and /factory:init, which onboards a brownfield repository in one command. Python, Node/TypeScript, Go and Rust adapters.
